contributions.statement: For very large tool catalogs, iterative search over the catalog beats a single top-k retrieval pass.
contributions.evidence: Table 1: trained multi-turn search F1 0.513 vs single-round RAG 0.194 (Qwen2.5-7B); 1.3-1.7pp over GDPO with one seed.

reason: RL training recipe for small tool-selection models; a team using hosted agents cannot act on it, and margins over the strongest baseline are noise-level.
